identified_issues: Epistemic underdetermination: Channel 1 strain bridge telemetry (+12.4 mV) cannot distinguish between transient thermal contraction (Mechanism A) and drive shaft shear micro-crack (Mechanism B).
Channel 2 ultrasonic pulse diagnostic is OFFLINE / NOT_EXECUTED, leaving physical shaft integrity unverified.
Premature claim promotion by operations engineers proposing PASS or FAIL without satisfying diagnostic and conditioning requirements.
evidence: Transducer Bridge Channel 1 measured value of +12.4 mV falls squarely within the +10 mV to +15 mV signature band for both Mechanism A and Mechanism B.
Housing temperature sensors are still transitioning and thermal equilibrium has not been reached.
Integrated ultrasonic pulse diagnostic on Channel 2 is marked OFFLINE / NOT_EXECUTED.
Downstream pressure is nominal and valve is stationary, confirming no acute containment failure but providing no proof of shaft structural integrity under load.
recommended_action: Hold the automated valve actuation sequence under whole-route overwatch. Bring the Channel 2 ultrasonic pulse diagnostic online to verify drive shaft acoustic continuity and allow propellant fill to reach thermal equilibrium before re-assessing valve operational readiness.
